night.headline: Pass tonight: no bet still has an edge once the model's edge is halved. Skipping costs no expected growth and cuts variance.
reasons: No total or parlay passed the edge filter tonight (each needs a conservative edge of at least the floor before it is sized), so nothing reaches the growth gate.
Reference ticket shrunk expected profit: 0.000% of bankroll (PASS below 0.050%, BET from 0.150%).
Reference tier: standard (200 units of $0.50 on $100); Kelly fraction 0.25 on shrunk edge.
At the reference unit no bet is placeable: one $0.50 unit is 0.5% of bankroll and no stake of that size grows the bankroll on any bet.
Shrinkage: totals and parlays at s = 0.5 (realised edge about half of claimed on 821 replay bets); props at s = 0, informational.
would_change: GTD starters in 6 priced games (NY@IND, MIL@ORL, CLE@MIA, ATL@CHI): a confirmed scratch re-prices those totals; stakes there are provisional until lineups post.

notes: Fair chance: DraftKings' no-vig price moved by the under lean, read at the line Fliff shows.
At DraftKings' own prices props have returned about nothing (unders -0.2% on 8,009 lines), so a prop is staked only where Fliff's line or price is better than the fair price.
Fliff's board was not read by this run (no Odds API key, or no credit left): type Fliff's line and odds into the page to price a prop.

Payout table (partly an assumption): Power 2/3/4/5/6 picks pay 3x/6x/10x/20x/37.5x and Flex 3/4/5/6 picks pay 3x/6x/10x/25x when all hit, per PrizePicks' help centre as summarised by web search on 2026-11-07 (the site itself is blocked from the build host). Flex partial tiers (3-pick 1x with one miss, 4-pick 1.5x, 5-pick 2x/0.4x, 6-pick 2x/0.4x) are from secondary sources. PrizePicks notes some lineups (e.g. several players from one game) pay differently: check the multiplier the app shows.
Minimum entry assumed $5 (official help centre, via web search 2026-11-07); Happy Hour promos can be lower.

Standard (non-Demon/Goblin) projections only. A voided pick (the player sits, or a tie on a whole-number line) is assumed to drop the slip one size at that size's payout; under two live picks it is refunded.
A slip needs players from at least two teams (assumed PrizePicks rule), and its picks are treated as independent.
PrizePicks pick'em was retired on 2026-11-12: player props are bet on Fliff.
Fliff minimum wager assumed $0.25 (ASSUMPTION, unverified; configurable in jghedge.config).
Game totals, cross-game parlays of totals and player props; spreads and moneylines are informational (lost in two of three replayed seasons).
Player props are staked only at a Fliff line and price that beat the DraftKings-based fair price (typed into the page, or read through an Odds API key).
Lines are DraftKings via ESPN unless an Odds API key supplies Fliff's own number; bet the number shown or better.

growth.basis: bootstrap of nightly returns from data/replay_open.json seasons 2024-2027 (1032 nights, both seeds); returns are the balanced profile at k=0.25 scaled by k/0.25 for other k; each night's stake is split across its bets, rounded to whole units, capped at 5% per bet and 10% per night, and the night is skipped when a bet rounds below one unit; 2000 paths of 160 nights, seed 1
